name: Sonic Who?
description: Clear the first dungeon in under 60 seconds.

name: Run Like an Egyptian
description: Clear the second dungeon in under 90 seconds.

name: Fenrir Couldn't Catch Me
description: Clear the third dungeon in under 4 minutes.

name: Wind Fire Wheels
description: Clear the fourth dungeon in under 3 minutes

name: Three Heads, One Victory
description: Defeat all three Cerberus heads in one encounter.

name: Serpent Slayer
description: Defeat the Snake miniboss.

name: Eight Legs, No Escape
description: Defeat Sleipnir, the eight-legged horse miniboss.

name: Dragon Slayer
description: Defeat the Chinese Dragon miniboss.

name: Vanquisher
description: Reach the final dungeon and defeat the final boss.

name: You killed 3 Medusa
description: Defeat 3 Medusas.

name: Stone Cold Killer
description: Don't look her in the eyes.||Defeat 10 Medusas.

name: Sand in My Eye
description: The Eye of Ra has seen better days.||Defeat 4 Sandeyes.

name: Mummy Issues
description: Unwrap their problems.||Defeat 6 Mummies.

name: Who Let the Wolves Out?
description: Fenrir's cousins are not happy.||Defeat 8 Wolves.

name: Elf on the Shelf (Deceased)
description: Santa's not coming back for them.||Defeat 15 Dark Elves.

name: Nevermore
description: Odin's spies, grounded.||Defeat 7 Crows.

name: Long Time, No Wei
description: Goodbye for good.||Defeat 15 Longwei.

name: Monkey Business
description: The Monkey King has friends. Fewer now.||Defeat 4 Wukongs.

name: Ah! Boy You killed 5 enemies
description: Defeat 5 enemies of any type.

name: Warm-Up Round
description: Your first real body count.||Defeat 20 enemies of any type.

name: Skill Issue (Theirs)
description: They should have practiced.||Defeat 50 enemies of any type.

name: Exterminator
description: Defeat 100 enemies of any type.

name: Hercules Called, He's Jealous
description: Twelve labours? You only need six.||Defeat at least one of each enemy in Dungeon One: Medusa, Minotaur, Harpy, Golem, Cyclops and Cerberus.

name: Monster Hunter: Dungeon Two
description: Defeat at least one of each enemy found in the second dungeon: Beetle, Crab, Wasp, Mummy and the Snake mini-boss.

name: Walk Like an Egyptian
description: Pharaoh's whole guest list.||Defeat at least one of each enemy in Dungeon Two: Sandeye, Beetle, Crab, Wasp, Mummy and the Snake mini-boss.

name: Ragnarok Rookie
description: The end is coming. Prepare.||Defeat at least one of each enemy in Dungeon Three: Wolf, Dark Elf, Crow, Knight, Jotunn and Sleipnir.

name: Journey to the West
description: Walk the path of the Monkey King.||Defeat at least one of each enemy in Dungeon Four: Bug, Longwei, Jingwei, Zombie, Wukong and the Dragon.

name: Boss Rush: Eat Your Heart Out
description: Every legend has a boss.||Defeat every boss: Cerberus, Snake, Sleipnir, Dragon and the final boss.

name: On a Roll
description: Defeat 5 enemies in a row without taking damage. Getting hit resets your streak.

name: Untouchable
description: Don't get hit. Not once.||Defeat 10 enemies in a row without taking damage.

name: Hacker? No, Just Good.
description: Surely you're cheating.||Defeat 20 enemies in a row without taking damage.

name: Coin Collector
description: Collect 10 gold coins.

name: Pocket Full of Gold
description: Your pockets are getting heavy.||Collect 50 gold coins.

name: Dragon's Hoard
description: Smaug would be proud.||Collect 100 gold coins.

name: First Steps
description: Clear the first dungeon from start to finish.

name: Into the Depths
description: Clear the second dungeon from start to finish.

name: Sanctum of Shadows
description: Clear the third dungeon from start to finish.

name: Dragon Gate Crasher
description: Leap the Dragon Gate.||Clear the fourth dungeon from start to finish.

name: The Final Showdown
description: Fight your way through the earlier dungeons and reach the final dungeon.

name: I need a break too
description: Hold your attacks during the pause in Stage 1.||Complete the full Stage 1 inter-wave break without hitting the Boss.

name: Coolin' off, make it fun
description: Try your ice projectile on the Boss in Stage 2.||Hit the Boss with a player ice projectile during Stage 2.

name: I'm fireproof!
description: Stay clear of the Boss's fire for all of Stage 2.||Complete Stage 2 without being hit by a Boss fireball.

name: Whoa! The Snow Queen
description: Let the Boss's ice reach you early in Stage 3.||Be hit by an ice projectile for the first time during Stage 3 Wave 1.

name: Brrr, it's freezing!
description: Take several ice hits in a row early in Stage 3.||Be hit in three consecutive ice volleys during Stage 3 Wave 1.

name: You flashed too fast
description: Get in close and strike the Boss first early in Stage 3.||Land the first sword or dagger hit on the Boss during Stage 3 Wave 1.

name: How can a statue even flash?
description: Keep an eye on the statues in the second wave of Stage 3.||Trigger the first successful statue teleport during Stage 3 Wave 2.
